mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_ID, N.TITLE, N.CREATED_BY, CU.USER_NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, N.CREATED_AT, N.UPDATED_BY, N.UPDATED_AT FROM NOTICE N JOIN USERS CU ON CU.USER_ID = N.CREATED_BY ORDER BY N.CREATED_AT DESC, N.NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT N.NOTICE_ID, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.CREATED_BY, CU.USER_NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, N.CREATED_AT, N.UPDATED_BY, UU.USER_NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, N.UPDATED_AT FROM NOTICE N JOIN USERS CU ON CU.USER_ID = N.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS UU ON UU.USER_ID = N.UPDATED_BY WHERE N.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{noticeId}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{createdBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
